title: Comunicado 2026-06-25
summary: Banxico's Board held the policy rate at 6.50% by a unanimous 5-0 vote with all members present, delivering the hold it had signaled in May and reiterating that going forward it will be appropriate to keep the rate at its current level, judging the monetary stance adequate for the macro challenges ahead. Versus the 7 May communique (a 25bp cut passed 3-2 that closed the easing cycle, composite -0.5), this is a modest hawkish step: the promised pause is now executed, and unanimously rather than by a divided majority. The inflation backdrop improved on the headline -- general inflation fell from 4.45% to 3.55% between April and the first half of June and the Q2 headline forecast was revised down -- but core only edged from 4.26% to 4.12%, core forecasts were nudged up for Q2-Q4, longer-term expectations stayed above target, and the balance of risks remains tilted to the upside. The hold leaned on the observed exchange-rate levels, the absence of demand-side pressures and continued slack, and the degree of monetary restriction already in place, with convergence to target still expected in Q2 2027. Net, an unanimous hold with an upside-tilted risk balance and continued emphasis on the priority price-stability mandate scores a mildly hawkish +0.5, up from -0.5 in May.

key_quotes.quote: con la presencia de todos sus miembros, decidió por unanimidad mantener el objetivo para la Tasa de Interés Interbancaria a un día en 6.50%.
key_quotes.context: The decision: a unanimous hold at 6.50% with all members present -- a shift from the divided 3-2 majority that delivered the final cut in May

key_quotes.quote: Hacia delante, la Junta de Gobierno considera que será apropiado mantener la tasa de referencia en su nivel actual.
key_quotes.context: Forward guidance reaffirms a firm hold at the current level, judging the stance adequate for the macro environment -- the pause promised in May is now the base case

key_quotes.quote: Se considera que el balance de riesgos respecto de la trayectoria prevista para la inflación en el horizonte de pronóstico mantiene un sesgo al alza.
key_quotes.context: Despite the sharp headline decline, the inflation risk balance stays tilted to the upside, with core sticky above 4%, core forecasts revised up for Q2-Q4 and longer-term expectations above target -- the rationale for holding

key_quotes.quote: Se siguen previendo condiciones de holgura a lo largo del horizonte de pronóstico y persisten importantes riesgos a la baja para la actividad económica.
key_quotes.context: Persistent slack and material downside risks to activity (Q1 contracted, Q2 expected to expand) are acknowledged but are not enough to reopen the easing cycle
